name: Notion Agents
desc: iPhone app for chatting with Notion Agents on the go.
desc_zh: 在 iPhone 上随时和 Notion 智能体对话的应用
solves: Your Notion agents only answered at your desk. The app takes voice, text and photo input and lets agents act from your phone.
solves_zh: 以前只有坐在电脑前才能找 Notion 智能体。这个应用支持语音、文字和拍照输入，在路上也能让它干活。
best_for: An idea hits on a walk and you want the agent to draft the page before you are back.
best_for_zh: 散步时想到一个点子，想赶回工位前就让智能体把页面写好。

The date used is the App Store one.
